purpose: Engineering pilot using available images; not the official full-cohort benchmark
fusion: elementwise maximum after independent Linear(512)+LayerNorm projections
selection: validation macro-F1, ties lower loss then earlier epoch; test once
train_images: RGB, RandomResizedCrop224 scale(0.8,1), ratio(0.75,4/3), bilinear antialias, ImageNet normalization; no flip or color augmentation
missing_images: Fail; no silent exclusion or placeholder image
recovery: Atomic complete-epoch checkpoint; unfinished epoch replayed from last complete epoch
scope: 2000 official-train + 300 official-validation + 300 official-test rows; all six classes in each split
